# docs.glean.com documentation

> Thank you for choosing Glean! As an administrator, you play a crucial role in setting up Glean for your organization.

Generated from a mirror of docs.glean.com by docset_refine on the hub; 4 pages. Companion files: llms-full.txt (all pages), llms-small.txt (reference pages within ~50k tokens), llms-facts.txt (extracted units).

## Get Started

- [Get started with Glean](https://docs.glean.com/get-started/welcome): Thank you for choosing Glean! As an administrator, you play a crucial role in setting up Glean for your organization.

## Administration

- [MCP insights](https://docs.glean.com/administration/insights/mcp-insights): The **MCP insights** dashboard helps you understand how your organization uses Glean's MCP servers across connected host applications.

## Tools

- [Google Docs tools](https://docs.glean.com/tools/connector/google-docs-tools): With Google Docs tools, you can create, update, copy, and edit documents directly from Glean without switching to Google Docs.

## Agents

- [Agent templates](https://docs.glean.com/agents/templates): Agent templates are pre-configured agents designed for common use cases across your organization.
